definitions.explanation: Written or typed material prepared for publication or presentation.

examples.japanese: {原稿|げんこう}を{編集者|へんしゅうしゃ}に{送|おく}った。
examples.english: I sent the manuscript to the editor.

examples.japanese: スピーチの{原稿|げんこう}を{準備|じゅんび}した。
examples.english: I prepared the script for the speech.

examples.japanese: {原稿|げんこう}{用紙|ようし}に{小説|しょうせつ}を{書|か}いている。
examples.english: I'm writing a novel on manuscript paper.

notes:
{原稿|げんこう} refers to written material intended for publication or presentation.

Common collocations:
- {原稿|げんこう}を{書|か}く (to write a manuscript)
- {原稿|げんこう}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する (to submit a manuscript)
- {原稿|げんこう}{用紙|ようし} (manuscript paper - special grid paper)
- {原稿|げんこう}{料|りょう} (manuscript fee, payment for writing)
- {原稿|げんこう}{締|し}め{切|き}り (manuscript deadline)

Types:
- {手書|てが}き{原稿|げんこう} (handwritten manuscript)
- {電子|でんし}{原稿|げんこう} (electronic manuscript)

Related terms:
- {草稿|そうこう} (draft)
- {下書|したが}き (draft, rough copy)
